🚨 SCAM ALERT - REVV Self Drive Cars 🚨

We booked an XUV300 for 10 days from Chandigarh, and from Day 2 our nightmare began. The car broke down in Spiti – wouldn’t start for 5+ hours in a no-network area. 15-20 locals helped us push; eventually, a local mechanic had to jumpstart the battery with his own vehicle. Day 3 was wasted checking the battery and fixing a pre-existing safety guard issue – we missed all our plans!

Despite the mechanic saying the battery was fine, the issue repeated on Day 6. We woke up every few hours to ensure the car started – until finally, at 5AM, it refused to start again. From 5AM to 2PM, we suffered pushing, jump-starting, waiting in the heat with no help from REVV. When we finally got it started, we rushed to Manali, ruining another day.

When we called our pickup contact Mr. Hussain, we were told to call Revv support – why was this not told earlier?

Here’s how REVV FAILED us:

1️⃣ Blamed us for not calling support earlier – despite their own staff (Mr. Hussain) being our contact.

2️⃣ Forced us to drive 1 hour to Mahindra service center in Manali, who said they needed the car for a day. Where were we supposed to go or stay in the middle of the highway?

3️⃣ We were forced to return to Chandigarh, ending our trip at 2AM after 6 days of frustration.

4️⃣ Miss Sharmila (Senior Manager) promised a minimum 50% refund if the vehicle was faulty.

5️⃣ After inspection, they admitted a problem – but only refunded 2 days of the trip (₹5400 out of ₹27,000) – WHAT ABOUT THE ENTIRE TRIP RUINED?

REVV = FRAUD. Horrible customer service. 90% of reviews on Google are negative, and now we know why. They loot customers with faulty cars, zero responsibility, and false promises.

We demand strict action and a full refund. This is not just bad service – it’s emotional harassment, financial loss, and pure negligence.

#RevvScam #FraudAlert #PatheticService

featured_reviews.review_text:
Out experience has been nothing short of frustrating and unprofessional.

Upon hiring a car for 7 days, I encountered an immediate issue when the battery was drained, causing a wasted hour at the airport before receiving a replacement vehicle. Furthermore, despite returning the car in the same condition it was handed over, I have not received my deposit back, and I was inappropriately charged an additional Rs 2500 for pre-existing damage.

When I sought clarification, your team resorted to threatening legal action instead of addressing the situation fairly. This treatment is unacceptable. It feels like your company is exploiting customers with unjust fines under the guise of service.
